{{Top|leg}}
'''Energy bars''' were used to create cages. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Grizzid]], while transporting a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], modified the cargo hold in his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] with energy bars. The [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Energy coupler/Legends|energy couplers]] were rigged to provide triple power to the containment system.<ref name="Rancor">{{WEGCite|story=A Rancor Comes to Tatooine|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
